instrument: Pima County Board of Supervisors moratorium on data center approvals
summary: A 120-day moratorium on new data center approvals in unincorporated Pima County, adopted 3-2. County staff are drafting a full data center policy targeted for board approval by December 10, 2026, and an ordinance is in development that would require a conditional use permit for hyperscale development, giving the board discretion to deny.
notes: Supervisors Christy and Scott opposed. The chief civil deputy county attorney briefed the board in executive session on legal exposure before the vote. Context: Project Blue's rezoning and land sale near the fairgrounds was approved roughly a year earlier and Tucson subsequently withdrew from the deal.
confidence_note: Relayed from reporting; the adopted resolution has not been read.
